Only paired TEXT4 candidate was measured. Both actual paired legs report gs64_tiles=true,twin=true,gs32_affine=false. No decode-twin fallback occurred; no GS32 VL candidate was enabled.

Peak physical footprint and maximum RSS are actual /usr/bin/time -l process measurements, not inferred GPU allocator/pinned-memory peaks.
Paired candidate versus current public is a full projection-path comparison, including tile/twin arithmetic; this screen does not isolate pair-wrapper-only cost.
M4 pair-only gains are retained separately and are not extrapolated to M5. This screen shows lower M5 decode throughput despite better paired cold prefill versus current.
Ten mirrored legs expose order variation but are not a thermal/frequency/bandwidth study; do not assign unmeasured hardware causes.
Correctness prerequisites do not establish an accepted whole-model fidelity/performance gate or full-backend qualification.
Fresh remote environment is separately frozen; transitive dependencies are not asserted identical to earlier or local M4 environments.
